description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Under Section 10 (3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act No. 20 of 2009 (Amended) Issuance of Certificate of Exemption
reasoning: The gazette content is a notification from the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka issuing a Certificate of Exemption under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act. It pertains to a regulatory matter (exempting a company from licensing requirements) based on an existing law. This fits the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5), which includes statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and legal notices issued under established acts.
